canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; contains the browser chrome strip at its top edge and the web page content below.

layers.description: Browser chrome strip along the window top: three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the browser window, docked to its top edge, spanning the full window width; the app card sits below it.

layers.description: A centered white application card with a thin light border, rounded corners and a subtle shadow; it holds the whole todo app.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered horizontally in the browser content area below the chrome; contains the card header, create row and list container stacked top to bottom.

layers.description: Card header band with the app title "My Todos" in large dark sans-serif text aligned to the left with padding.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child inside the app card, directly under its top edge; title aligned to the card left padding.

layers.description: Create row with a single-line text input showing grey placeholder text "Add a new todo…", a blue filled button labeled "Add" immediately to the right of the input, and small grey helper text "Up to 500 characters" under the input.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the header; input and button share one horizontal line, helper text left-aligned under the input.

layers.description: Rounded list container with a hairline border holding four todo rows stacked vertically with thin dividers, oldest at the top.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the app card below the create row, spanning the card inner width; owns all four todo rows in creation order.

layers.description: Todo row 1 of 4, first in creation order, shown in normal mode: a square checkbox at the left filled blue with a white checkmark, done todo text "Buy milk" in faded grey with a horizontal strikethrough, and two small grey text-buttons labeled "Edit" and "Delete" aligned at the right end of the row.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: First child of the list container; checkbox left-aligned, text left-aligned after the checkbox, action buttons right-aligned; same row layout grid as the other normal rows.

layers.description: Todo row 2 of 4, a slightly taller row whose just-rejected text edit left everything intact: a square checkbox at the left filled blue with a white checkmark, the original done todo text "Pay electricity bill" still shown in faded grey with a horizontal strikethrough, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Second child of the list container directly below the first row; same layout grid as the first row with extra blank space reserved under the text for its error line.

layers.description: Todo row 3 of 4 in inline edit mode: its empty unchecked square checkbox still visible at the left, the row text replaced by an inline single-line text input prefilled with the dark text "Walk the dog in the park", and at the right end a blue filled button labeled "Save" followed by a grey text-button labeled "Cancel".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Third child of the list container directly below the second row; the inline input fills the horizontal space where the row text was, aligned to the same text baseline, buttons right-aligned on the same line as the checkbox.

layers.description: Todo row 4 of 4, newest at the bottom, shown in normal mode: an empty unchecked square checkbox at the left, not-done todo text "Read 20 pages" in normal dark text, and the same pair of small grey row action text-buttons as the first row aligned at the right end.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Fourth child of the list container, last in creation order; identical layout grid to the first row.

layers.description: Rejection error surface attached to the second todo row: small red text reading "Text is required" in the blank space directly under that row's original text, marking its rejected text edit while the row keeps its original text and done state.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Owned by the second todo row, left-aligned with that row's text, contained within that row's band.
